;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[London]]-based [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] reports that unidentified rebel factions have shot down a [[Russia]]n [[Sukhoi Su-25]] jet over the [[Idlib Governorate]], near [[Maarrat al-Nu'man]], also [[Russian Armed Forces casualties in Syria|killing its pilot]]. The pilot had escaped with his parachute but was killed on the ground while he fought with a pistol to evade capture. No groups claim responsibility. Russia's [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Ministry of Defence]] corroborates this version of events. [http://www.dw.com/en/syria-rebels-shoot-down-russian-jet-capture-pilot-monitor/a-42442483 (Deutsche Welle)]
**The [[Interfax]] agency states that [[Russia]] retaliated with a missile attack, killing at least 30 [[Al-Nusra Front|Al-Nusra]] militants in [[Northwestern Syria campaign (October 2017–present)|North-West Syria]] with "precision-guided weapons". [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/02/03/syria-rebels-shoot-down-russian-jet-monitoring-group-says/303713002/ (''USA Today'')]
**According to [[Sputnik (news agency)|Sputnik]] agency, [[Tahrir al-Sham]], allegedly including Al-Nusra Front, claims in a social media post that it downed the Russian jet with a [[Shoulder-launched surface-to-air missile|shoulder-launched anti-aircraft missile]]. [https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201802031061334492-syria-su25-jihadists-jet-missile/ (Sputnik News)]
**The [[Turkish Land Forces|Turkish Army]] suffers its deadliest day of [[Turkish military operation in Afrin|Operation Olive Branch]] so far after seven soldiers are killed in clashes with the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]] [[People's Protection Units|YPG]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-42934041 (BBC)]
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**A [[Terrorism in Pakistan|suicide bombing]], revindicated in an email to journalists by the [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan|Pakistani Taliban]], kills at least 11 soldiers and injures 13 at an army unit camp's sports area in the [[Kabal Tehsil|Kabal]] area of the [[Swat Valley]], in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa|Northwestern Pakistan]], according to [[Pakistan Army]] figures. [http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2018/02/04/suicide-bomber-kills-11-soldiers-in-nw-pakistan.html (AFP via ''The Jakarta Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Macerata shooting]]
**A shooting in [[Macerata]], [[Italy]], leaves six African immigrants wounded. The suspect is arrested and the case is being treated as a racially motivated crime. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42930749 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[15760 Albion]] (previously 1992 QB<sub>1</sub>), the first discovered [[Kuiper belt]] object, is officially named by its discoverers. [https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/ECS/MPCArchive/2018/MPC_20180131.pdf#page=955 (Minor Planet Center)]

;Sports
*[[2018 UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships]]
**[[Sanne Cant]] outduels [[Katie Compton]] in [[UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships – Women's elite race|women's elite race]] at the [[UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships]] in [[Valkenburg (city)|Valkenburg]], [[Netherlands]], winning her second title. [https://www.cxmagazine.com/sanne-cant-katie-compton-women-2018-cyclocross-world-championships-valkenburg-report (''CX Magazine'')]
